quarterly_data.quarter: ArianeGroup press release: Arianespace to launch 36 Amazon Leo satellites on November (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Arianespace will launch 36 Amazon Leo satellites aboard Ariane 6 in its Ariane 64 (four-booster) configuration from Europe's Spaceport in French Guiana no earlier than November 23 (mission VA271 / LE-04; final launch window to be set closer to the mission). It is the 10th Ariane 6 flight and 4th flight of Ariane 64, the 2nd Ariane 64 mission with P160C solid rocket boosters, and Arianespace's 363rd launch and 5th in 2026; the launch campaign is underway at the Guiana Space Center.
quarterly_data.figure: 36 satellites; no earlier than November 23; 10th Ariane 6 flight

quarterly_data.quarter: ArianeGroup press release: Arianespace to launch 36 Amazon Leo satellites on November (10-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer Amazon: Arianespace has a 24-launch agreement with Amazon to support the deployment of the Amazon Leo constellation; in September 2026 Amazon announced six additional Ariane 64 launches under the agreement. VA271 / LE-04 is the fourth Ariane 6 launch dedicated to Amazon Leo and, upon success, brings the satellites Arianespace has deployed for Amazon to 136.
quarterly_data.figure: 24-launch agreement; six additional Ariane 64 launches (September 2026); 136 satellites

contracts.signal: VA271 / LE-04 (36 Amazon Leo satellites on Ariane 64, no earlier than November 23) is part of Arianespace's 24-launch agreement with Amazon to support the deployment of the Amazon Leo constellation; in September 2026 Amazon announced six additional Ariane 64 launches under the agreement. It is the fourth Ariane 6 launch dedicated to Amazon Leo (the 4th Arianespace mission for Amazon Leo in 2026) and would bring the total satellites deployed by Arianespace for Amazon to 136.
